messages:
alex: :rotating_light: eu-north1 reports multiple pod evictions on gpu-pool-2. ~30% of GPUs flapped in the last 6m, driver resets + OOMs. latency spikes on gen endpoints.
ops-bot: Alert: infra.eunorth1.gpu_pool2.evictions >= 20 in 5m. Incident opened (INC-2026-421).
alex: putting this here to coordinate mitigation. need to protect critical tenants first.
mira: pulling node logs and dmesg now, attaching GPU-driver traces. will post key snippets.
jordan: proposal: apply emergency per-customer caps for noisy tenants and redispatch best-effort traffic to us-west1/dedicated pools. avoids spin-up of new GPUs.
ben: +1 to redispatch. cost of new nodes will be high and slow. can we fast-path some traffic to dedicated? which customers are "noisy" today?
simone: list from last 24h: bigco, acme-ml, rapidchat have the highest sustained token/sec. recommend 50-60% cap for those three, keep gold customers at 90%.
alex: ok push softcaps now. jordan, can you update limiter config? we need minimal disruption but strict enough to keep below 70% aggregate usage.
jordan: updating rate-limiter service. will apply selector-based caps. config below:
```json
{
  "version": "v1",
  "rules": [
    { "selector": "tenant==\"bigco\"", "max_tokens_per_min": 200000, "burst": 5000 },
    { "selector": "tenant==\"acme-ml\"", "max_tokens_per_min": 150000, "burst": 4000 },
    { "selector": "tenant==\"rapidchat\"", "max_tokens_per_min": 100000, "burst": 2000 },
    { "selector": "tier==\"gold\"", "max_tokens_per_min": 250000, "burst": 8000 }
  ]
}
```
ops-bot: rate-limiter config applied at 1801234702 by jordan.
ben: starting traffic redistribution script to shift non-critical routes to us-west1 and dedicated pools. running dry-run first.
alex: command for redispatch if folks want to inspect:
```bash
./tools/redispatch --from-region eu-north1 --to-regions us-west1,eu-west1 --routes "gen/*,chat/*" --dry-run
```
mira: logs show kernel OOM pattern on 3 nodes, same driver version nvidia-driver 525.21. restarting kubelet on affected nodes to see if eviction halt helps.
support-bot: creating support tickets for customers impacted by caps: #TICK-452 (bigco), #TICK-453 (acme-ml), #TICK-454 (rapidchat). Please add context and expected restore ETA.
simone: drafting status page and customer PSA now. recommend wording: "We are applying temporary per-tenant usage caps in eu-north1 to protect overall capacity. Some requests may be rate-limited. We are investigating and will follow up."
alex: timeline: immediate caps applied (done), redispatch in next 10m (in progress), node restarts and driver traces 10-30m, recovery target 60m but TBD.
jordan: monitoring metrics: aggregate GPU utilization dropped from 93% -> 68% after caps. token rate for bigco down ~55%. latency for gold routes stable.
ben: dry-run looks good, initiating actual reroute now.
ops-bot: reroute job started (job-id reroute-1801234788).
mira: collected dmesg and gpu traces, uploading to s3://infra-debug/eunorth1/1801234567-traces.tar.gz. sending to driver team.
support-bot: posted status page update: "Degraded GPU capacity in eu-north1; temporary per-tenant caps in effect; some customers may see rate-limits. Engineers are redispatching traffic and investigating root cause."
simone: customer comms ready for review. @alex want to sign off before I send?
alex: please send. mention expected 1-2 hour window and link to ticket.
jordan: will keep rate-limiter logs on for 2hrs and rollback if we see false positives.
oncall-bot: oncall escalation: paged infra oncall simone -> acknowledged.
support-bot: Support triage lane: prioritize gold customers and escalate any SLA breaches immediately.
ben: FYI cost note: if we end up spinning burst nodes we'll use reserved dedicated pools first, then spot as last resort. notify finance if we exceed $X/day.
alex: action items recorded: mira (driver traces + node health), jordan (rate-limiter monitoring + rollback plan), ben (redispatch ops + fallback), simone (customer comms + status), support (tickets).
mira: got initial driver team's comments: maybe a flaky firmware. sending hardware traces to vendor.
jordan: metrics look stable post actions. continued monitoring.
simone: PSA sent. confirmations received from bigco & acme-ml support contacts.
alex: great work everyone. keep channel for updates only; create followup postmortem doc after recovery. :thumbsup:
ben: :thumbsup:
